rationale.summary: A warm, welcoming landing page for a local yoga studio that combines a calming aesthetic with clear class scheduling and easy sign-up pathways. The design projects professionalism and tranquility to attract new students across all experience levels.
rationale.audience: People in the Portland area seeking yoga classes—both beginners looking for an accessible entry point and experienced practitioners seeking specialized instruction. Visitors want to quickly understand what classes are available, when they run, and how to join.

colors.name: warm brown
colors.why: Primary brand color that evokes earth, stability, and natural wellness—appropriate for a yoga studio. Used for headings to create visual hierarchy and calm authority.

colors.name: tan/gold accent
colors.why: Warm accent that adds elegance and draws attention to key interactive elements (borders, hover states). Suggests warmth and mindfulness without feeling corporate.

colors.name: cream
colors.why: Soft, neutral background used in hero and about sections. Creates a serene, uncluttered backdrop that feels spacious and meditative.

colors.name: off-white
colors.why: Subtle background for the classes and contact sections. Provides gentle contrast while maintaining the overall calm, light aesthetic.

colors.name: dark charcoal
colors.why: Primary text color for body copy and footer. High contrast with light backgrounds ensures readability; darker tone grounds the design.

colors.name: medium gray
colors.why: Secondary text for descriptions and supporting details. Slightly lighter than primary text to create visual hierarchy without reducing legibility.

rationale.typography: Segoe UI and system fonts provide clean, modern, accessible readability on all devices. Font weights (400, 500, 600, 700) create clear distinction between headings, navigation, and body text. The sans-serif choice feels contemporary while maintaining the serene, uncluttered tone appropriate to wellness.
rationale.layout: Hero section with prominent call-to-action immediately captures attention and communicates the studio's mission. Class schedule follows, displayed as scannable cards so visitors can quickly find times and instructors. About section builds trust with qualifications and studio benefits. Contact section with form and details closes the journey. This order moves visitors from emotional connection → practical information → trust → action.
rationale.conversion: Multiple sign-up buttons are strategically placed: a prominent CTA in the hero (primary action), individual buttons on each class card (micro-conversions leading to enrollment), and a contact form at the bottom (secondary capture). Trust elements include instructor names and experience level, studio amenities, and clear contact details. Hover effects on buttons provide visual feedback that encourages clicks.
